answer: Each agent bonds stake to a Semaphore identity and evaluates the epoch’s committed rate-limit polynomial. A zero-knowledge proof lets messages verify membership and quota compliance without exposing identity. If the same identity exceeds its quota, distinct message shares expose the Shamir secret—and thus its private key—by interpolation; the contract then slashes the bond immediately. This makes Sybil identities costly: ember, dawn, and violet cannot multiply one agent’s quota without risking collateral.
